live2d.description: The Live2D track hosts story playback and model inspection. Route shells are in place; the player adapter comes next.
live2d.modelSelector.description: Browse the preview slots below or type any path-safe model ID to open its viewer route. Every entry is a placeholder — no verified catalog or model data exists yet.
live2d.modelSelector.empty: No preview models are listed yet.
live2d.modelSelector.inputError: That model ID is not path-safe. Use letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only.
live2d.modelSelector.inputHint: Letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores. Unknown IDs open the stub viewer route.
live2d.modelSelector.model.preview01.des: Reserved placeholder slot for a future verified catalog entry.
live2d.modelSelector.model.preview02.des: Reserved placeholder slot for a future verified catalog entry.
live2d.modelSelector.model.sample.descri: Placeholder entry wired to the sample viewer route. No real model data.
live2d.modelSelector.model.sample.title: Sample model slot
live2d.modelSelector.title: Model catalog
live2d.modelViewer.controls.hint: Controls unlock once the model player adapter mounts and a model is ready.
live2d.modelViewer.controls.title: Playback controls
live2d.modelViewer.description: Load a single Cubism model to preview its motions and expressions on a dedicated stage. The route validates the model ID; the model player adapter comes next.
live2d.modelViewer.sampleNote: Sample routes show stubbed metadata only — no model data is fetched yet.
live2d.modelViewer.stage.reserved: Model stage reserved — the canvas mounts here once the player adapter lands.
live2d.modelViewer.status.description: The route validates the model ID and reserves the stage; Cubism loading and playback controls arrive with the model player adapter work.
live2d.modelViewer.status.label: Viewer status
live2d.modelViewer.status.title: Model player adapter not wired up yet
live2d.modelViewer.status.unavailableDes: The approved catalog has not yet provided a verified model descriptor and asset sample for this route. Playback remains disabled rather than guessing model files or another region's assets.
live2d.modelViewer.status.unavailableTit: This model cannot be loaded yet
live2d.modelViewer.stage.unavailable: Stage reserved — verified model assets are not available yet.
live2d.modelViewer.title: Model Viewer
live2d.storyReader.description: StoryReader routes validate the region, story type, and story ID, then reserve the reader stage with stub metadata until scenario fetching is wired up.
live2d.storyReader.sampleNote: Sample routes show stubbed metadata only — no story data is fetched yet.
live2d.storyReader.title: StoryReader
